content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a CEO position at the Confederation of Finnish Industries. Tell about your experience in business advocacy, labor market policy, and representing corporate interests. Also describe how you have promoted the competitiveness and growth conditions of Finnish businesses. Length about 380 words.
